# Draft:Global Crusade with Kumuyi (GCK)

Global Crusade with Kumuyi is an international evangelical Christian outreach organization led by Pastor William F. Kumuyi, the General Superintendent of the Deeper Christian Life Ministry. The crusade aims to spread the gospel of Jesus Christ, promote moral and spiritual revival, and address societal issues through large-scale evangelistic events, teachings, and community impact initiatives. The program has been held in various countries across the globe, attracting millions of participants both in-person and through digital platforms.
History
The Global Crusade with Kumuyi began in June 2021 as an extension of the evangelistic efforts of the Deeper Christian Life Ministry, which was founded by Pastor William F. Kumuyi in Lagos, Nigeria, in 1973. The church ministry initially focused on Bible studies and local outreach but expanded to international crusades in the 1990s. The Global Crusade with Kumuyi was formally established to reach a broader audience and address the spiritual needs of people worldwide. The first crusade was held in Abuja Nigeria in June, 2021.
Impact and Reach
The Global Crusade with Kumuyi has been held in numerous countries across Africa, Australia, Oceania, North America, and Asia. Some notable locations include:
* Nigeria
* The Phillippines
* India
* Canada
* Togo
* Vanuatu
* New Zealand
* Australia
* Ghana
* Zambia
* Cameroon
The crusade has also leveraged technology to reach a global audience through live streaming, television broadcasts, and social media platforms.
As at 2024, unconfirmed numbers attributed commulative physical attendance at the Crusade to stand at over 5 million people with 700,000 making a commitment to be converted.
The Crusades has had National and subnational leaders in attendance since inception. The President of the Republic of Zambia, Hakainde Hichilema, Vanuatu's President Nikenike Vurobaravu, Nigeria's former president, Olusegun Obasanjo, and others. This impact of the GCK has led to the Convener, Pastor Kumuyi, being invited to the US Presidential Inauguration and leading prayers at one of the inauguration prayer breakfast in Washington.
